Investing in San Diego County Tax Deeds: Your Guide to High Returns

San Diego County, California’s tax deed investing is an exciting opportunity. With high demand for property and limited land, investors can find significant property discounts at county auctions. Here’s how to start getting 18-36% returns on your investment and purchase property for as little as $500.

What is Tax Deed Investing?

Tax deed investing involves buying properties at auctions that have been defaulted on their taxes. The winner of the auction gets ownership of the property at a fraction of its market value.

Why San Diego?

San Diego’s real estate market is driven by two main factors: demand and scarcity. The high rental demand and limited land, especially in coastal areas, drive property values up. This makes San Diego a great location for tax deed investing.

Steps to Start Tax Deed Investing in San Diego

  1. Visit the San Diego County Treasurer-Tax Collector’s Website:
    • Check the San Diego Treasurer and Tax Collector’s website for auction details.
  2. Find Property Tax Auction Information:
    • Under the “Tax Collection” section, look for “Property Tax Auction.”
  3. Explore Auction Details:
    • Click on the ‘auction website’ to find all related information.
  4. Read the Instructions:
    • Go through the ‘Tax Sale Instructions’ carefully to understand the rules and processes.
  5. Watch Demo Videos:
    • These will show you how to register and complete pre-auction requirements.

Key Tips for Success

  • Stay Updated: Sign up for e-notifications to stay informed about upcoming property tax auctions.
  • Be Cautious: Check for any remaining liens on properties, such as municipal and federal liens, and be aware of additional costs related to the auction.
  • Post-Auction Steps: After winning a bid, wait until you have the physical tax deed before accessing the property.

FAQs

  1. What are the typical dates for tax deed sales in San Diego?
    • Tax deed sales in San Diego usually occur in March.
  2. Is there a redemption period for tax deeds in San Diego?
    • No, there is no redemption period for tax deeds in San Diego.
  3. What is the interest rate for tax deeds in San Diego?
    • There is no interest rate for tax deeds in San Diego.
  4. How do I bid at a San Diego tax deed auction?
    • Bids are placed through a premium bid procedure.
  5. Where can I find more information about upcoming auctions?
    • Visit the San Diego Treasurer and Tax Collector’s website and the Bid4Assets website for the latest information.
